{{Vanilla|Block of Redstone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
An '''electric block''' is a permanent power source. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Block of Redstone|block of redstone}} under a new name, and it works the same way.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Nine [[Electric Wire|electric wire]] make an electric block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/redstone_block.json}}</ref> Unlike in vanilla, the block cannot be crafted back into wire: the vanilla recipe that does so is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]] sells 64 electric blocks for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/1/redstone_block.json}}</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Because an electric block cannot be uncrafted, 64 electric blocks from the Engineer cannot be turned into wire or copper.
